plugin.name: Condemned Widescreen Fix
FixAspectRatio.description: Correct non-16:9 aspect ratios and allow all native Config.exe resolutions.
FixMenu.description: Correct stretched menu backgrounds by adjusting their vertical scale.
FixLowFramerate.description: Restrict native DirectInput enumeration to game controllers to avoid the existing frame-rate drop.
FixSavePath.description: Redirect the native public-documents save path to personal documents. Existing native saves are copied if the target does not yet exist.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view; larger is wider. Scripted cameras and zoomed views keep their own.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the startup logo videos. Needs a restart.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Select the native fix menu language. Auto uses a supported detected language, or English when detection or translation is unavailable. Reopen Plugins to apply.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Recommended: the defaults. Enhanced: everything turned up.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
WindowMode.description: Choose fullscreen, windowed or borderless. Needs a restart; no autoexec.cfg change is needed.
